```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggsci)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Get annotation
```{r}
  annotation<-read.table("../sampleSheet_model1.txt",header = T,sep = "\t",row.names=1)
  row.names(annotation) <- gsub("-", ".", row.names(annotation))
  annotation$sample <- gsub("-", ".", annotation$sample)
  annotation
```
# Model Building
## 1. Get miRNA data
```{r}
  df<-read.table("mature_sense_minExpr0_RCadj_libraryRPM.mat",header = T,sep = "\t",row.names = 1)

  colnames(df) <- gsub("-", ".", colnames(df))
  df <- na.omit(df)
  keep <- rowSums(df>0) > 0
  df <- df[keep, ]
  dim(df)
  genes <- rownames(df)[grep("*Hsa", rownames(df))]
  
  df <- df[genes,]

```

## 2. Get data for model building

```{r}
  modelBuildingSamples <- annotation[annotation$group == 'Healthy'|annotation$group =="Active Disease",]$sample

  dfModel <- df[,modelBuildingSamples]
```


## 3. Filter data (at least one third of the observations not zero)

```{r}
  totalBuildingCohort = length(modelBuildingSamples)
  keep <- rowSums(dfModel > 0) >= (totalBuildingCohort/3)
  analysis_df <- dfModel[keep,]
  dim(analysis_df)

```
  
## 4. Make train 2/3 and test 1/3 + create dataframes

```{r}

  set.seed(12345)
  
#Healthy
  responders <- annotation[annotation$group == 'Healthy',]
  sample_size = floor((2/3)*length(responders$sample))

  picked = sample(seq_len(nrow(responders)),size = sample_size)
  train_responder = responders[picked,]$sample
  test_responder = responders[-picked,]$sample
  
#NonResponder
  ADs <- annotation[annotation$group == 'Active Disease',]
  sample_size = floor((2/3)*length(ADs$sample))
  
  picked = sample(seq_len(nrow(ADs)),size = sample_size)
  train_nonresponder = ADs[picked,]$sample
  test_nonresponder = ADs[-picked,]$sample
  
  train_samples <- c(train_responder,train_nonresponder)
  response_train <- c(rep("Healthy",length(train_responder)),rep("Active Disease",length(train_nonresponder)))
  
  test_samples <- c(test_responder,test_nonresponder)
  response_test <- c(rep("Healthy",length(test_responder)),rep("Active Disease",length(test_nonresponder)))
  
  #Train and test df
  analysisDf <- t(analysis_df)
  train <- analysisDf[train_samples,]
  test <- analysisDf[test_samples,]
    
```
  
## 5. Lasso Model

```{r}
  library(glmnet)

  set.seed(12345)
  alfa = 1
  lasso.reg <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train), response_train,
                           alpha = alfa, family="binomial", 
                           type.measure="class", nfolds=6, standarize=T)
  plot(lasso.reg)
  #Best lambda = min_lambda
  min_lambda <- lasso.reg$lambda.min
            
  #MCE of that model
  mce <- lasso.reg$cvm[which(lasso.reg$lambda == lasso.reg$lambda.min)]
  
  #Optimal model -> Best lambda
  lasso.opt = glmnet(x=train, 
                       y=response_train, 
                       alpha=alfa,standarize=T, 
                       lambda = min_lambda,family="binomial",nfolds=6,type.measure="class")
            
            
    bestModel <- lasso.opt
    bestMCE = mce
    alfaB <- alfa

```
  
# Test in validation samples
  
```{r}
  prediction_train <- predict(bestModel, as.matrix(train), type = "response")
  gModTrain <- pROC::roc(response_train ~ prediction_train, plot = TRUE, print.auc = TRUE)
  ROCtrain <- pROC::coords(gModTrain, "best", ret=c("ci","auc","threshold", "sens", "spec", "ppv", "npv"))
  thresholdTrain <- ROCtrain$threshold
  prediction <- predict(bestModel, as.matrix(test), type = "response")
  
  #define object to plot and calculate AUC
  rocClassical <- pROC::roc(response_test, prediction,threshold=thresholdTrain,ci=TRUE)

  #create ROC plot
  pROC::ggroc(rocClassical,size = 2,color="#dea221") +
      geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=1,colour="black",linetype = "dashed")+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=18,color="black"),axis.title=element_text(size=26))+
      ylab("Sensitivity")+
      xlab("1-Specificity")+
      theme(legend.text=element_text(size=18),legend.position = c(0.6,0.15),
            legend.background = element_rect(fill="white",size=0.5, linetype="solid",colour = "black"),
            legend.title = element_blank())+
      scale_color_futurama()
```
